content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of FUNWAVE-TVD dispersion.F containing the single subroutine CAL_DISPERSION (L73-403), which computes the Boussinesq dispersion terms (header L57-58: 'so far V^4 and V^1', called by MAIN, calls DERIVATIVE_XX/XY per L59-62; history L64-70: Shi 05/2010, coupling bc + xx_high->second order per Harris 10/14/2012, ykchoi 08/2015 t-derivative corrections to U1p,V1p,V2,V3,omega_1). Algorithm: (1) spatial derivatives of U,V via DERIVATIVE_XX/XY/YY calls (L86-92); if Gamma2>0 also Ux,Vx,Uy,Vy,ETAx,ETAy (L95-101), else if SHOW_BREAKING only ETAx,ETAy (L102-105). (2) DU,DV = max(Depth,MinDepthFrc)*U,V and mass-flux-based ETAT(I,J)=-(P(I+1,J)-P(I,J))/DX-(Q(I,J+1)-Q(I,J))/DY over J=1,Nloc-1/I=1,Mloc-1 (L108-120; comment L113-116 notes ykchoi 05/25/2018 pointed a bug: loop should be J=1,Nloc, I=1,Mloc). (3) If Gamma2>0, backward-difference time derivatives Ut=(U-U0)/DT, Vt=(V-V0)/DT and DUt,DVt (L133-142; comment L126-128: per Steve Brandt Ut,Vt should be evaluated outside the RK loop, kept temporarily, important for hot start); an ELSEIF(SHOW_BREAKING .OR. WAVEMAKER_VIS) branch is empty (L144-146). (4) derivatives of DU,DV (L149-155) and, when Gamma2>0, of Ut,Vt,DUt,DVt (L158-178). (5) MPI-boundary zeroing of cross-derivatives Uxy,DUxy,Vxy,DVxy,Utxy,DUtxy,Vtxy,DVtxy at west (skipped when WaveMaker(1:11)=='LEFT_BC_IRR', L185-200), east, south, north edges when the neighbor rank is MPI_PROC_NULL (L204-241), then CALL EXCHANGE_DISPERSION (L244). (6) Main loop J=1,Nloc/I=1,Mloc (L248-293): U4,V4 dispersion terms with Beta_1 coefficients (L250-253), ykchoi 04/14/2017 gamma2 nonlinear additions via ken1,ken2 (L255-272), and U1p,V1p with the ykchoi 08/2015 corrected coefficient 0.5*(1-Beta_1)^2 (L281-290; original 0.5*(1-Beta_1) kept as comments L280,L286). (7) If gamma2>0, second loop J=Jbeg,Jend/I=Ibeg,Iend (L297-401): centered differences of the grouped second derivatives (UxxVxy_x etc., L303-313), rh,rhx,rhy,reta (L315-318), time-derivative terms U1pp,V1pp (L320-324) plus ykchoi remaining Shi et al. (2012) terms via ken1-ken4 (L326-334), nonlinear convective dispersion U2,V2 via ken1-ken5 (L336-367; ken1 redefined for V2 at L357 per ykchoi 08/2015 correction), vorticity omega_0=Vx-Uy (L369), omega_1 per Shi et al. (2012) with b2 coefficient (L373-374), omega=omega_0+omega_1 (L376) with optional VorticityMax tracking under OUT_VORmax (L378-382), and vortex-force terms U3=-V*omega_1-omega_0*(ken1*HUxyHVyy+ken2*UxyVyy), V3=U*omega_1+omega_0*(...) (L384-396). All state arrays (U,V,Eta,P,Q,U4,V4,U1p,V1p,U1pp,V1pp,U2,V2,U3,V3,Uxx..DVtxy,ETAT,omega,VorticityMax,Beta_1,Beta_2,b2,gamma2,MASK9 etc.) come from USE GLOBAL (L74).

equations.ref: Etat from flux divergence, conservative form of Shi et al. (2012), comments L113-116
U4 dispersion term, continuation +(Beta_1-1.0_SP/2.0_SP)*DEPTH*(DUxx+DVxy) on L251
V4 dispersion term, continuation on L253
ykchoi 04/14/2017 gamma2 coefficient, continuation on L267
U1p with ykchoi-corrected squared coefficient (old form commented at L280), continuations L282-284
centered x-derivative of Uxx+Vxy; analogous UxxVxy_y @L304, UxyVyy_x @L305, UxyVyy_y @L306, HUxxHVxy_x @L310, HUxxHVxy_y @L311, HUxyHVyy_x @L312, HUxyHVyy_y @L313
U1pp time-derivative dispersion, continuation on L321; V1pp @L323-324
ykchoi 2015.08.06 remaining U1p/V1p terms of Shi et al. (2012), with ken2 @L329, ken3 @L330, ken4 @L331

equations.expr: U1pp(I,J) = U1pp(I,J) - ken1*UxxVxy - ken2*( Utxx(I,J)+Vtxy(I,J) ) + ken3*HUxxHVxy + ken4*(DUtxx(I,J)+DVtxy(I,J))

equations.ref: U2 coefficient; ken2 @L337, ken3 @L338-339, ken4 @L340-341, ken5 @L342-343
ken1 modified for V2 per ykchoi 15.08.06 comment L356-357
omega_1 per Shi et al. (2012), continuation on L374

verbatim_spans.text: ! 05/25/2018, ykchoi pointed a bug: J=1,Nloc, I=1,Mloc
! as pointed by Steve Brandt, Ut and Vt should be evaluated outside of RK loop.
! U1p, V1p terms are modified to 0.5_SP*(1.0_SP-Beta_1) --> 0.5_SP*(1.0_SP-Beta_1)*(1.0_SP-Beta_1)

unresolved: Comment L116 records a known bug (loop bounds should be J=1,Nloc, I=1,Mloc) but the code at L108-109 still loops J=1,Nloc-1, I=1,Mloc-1 — i.e. ETAT and DU/DV are not computed on the last row/column in this version
ELSEIF(SHOW_BREAKING .OR. WAVEMAKER_VIS) branch at L144-146 is empty — ETAT needed for breaking is computed unconditionally at L118, so the branch body may have been moved out; intent not stated
b2 used in omega_1 (L373-374) is not declared locally and its relation to Beta_1/Beta_2 comes from GLOBAL (cross-file)
Loop indices I,J and neighbor-rank variables n_west,n_east,n_suth,n_nrth, MPI_PROC_NULL come from USE GLOBAL (cross-file)

U1p/V1p (L281-290) use Uxx,Vxy,DUxx,DVxy computed only by second-order DERIVATIVE_XX/XY (L86-92) — header comment L66-67 says derivative_xx_high was changed to second order per Harris suggestion; the _HIGH variants defined in derivatives.f90 are not called here
EXCHANGE_DISPERSION (L244) and DERIVATIVE_* are defined in other files (cross-file)
